item.title: Training course: EUMETSAT/ECMWF NWP-SAF satellite data assimilation — ECMWF Events (Indico)
item.description: Dates: 18 Jan – 22 Jan 2027 · 5 days. Location: ECMWF, Reading. Deadline: 2026-09-27. Fee EUR 0 · Apply on official page. Topics: satellite, machine learning

item.title: Winter School on Federalism and Governance 2027 — Eurac Research and University of Innsbruck
item.description: Dates: 1 Feb – 12 Feb 2027 · 12 days. Location: Innsbruck / Bolzano/Bozen. Deadline: 2026-10-12. EUR 300 participation fee, excluding accommodation · Limited scholarships: 2 full and 3 partial; recipients still pay EUR 150. Full: accommodation, breakfast and a small travel contribution; partial: accommodation and breakfast. · Apply on official page. Topics: law, political science, AI governance

item.title: VIASM-IAMP Summer School 2027 on Probability and Mathematical Physics — Vietnam Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics (VIASM)
item.description: Dates: 23 Jul – 28 Jul 2027 · 6 days. Location: Vietnam Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics (VIASM), Hanoi. Deadline: 2027-07-01. Fee EUR 0 · Apply on official page. Topics: probability, mathematical physics, statistical physics, mathematics

item.title: Neutron and Muon School 2026 (Japanese-language) — J-PARC Neutron and Muon School
item.description: Dates: 9 Nov – 13 Nov 2026 · 5 days. Location: Tokai, Ibaraki, Japan (AQBRC, J-PARC and JRR-3). Deadline: 2026-09-30. JPY 40,000 (meals and accommodation require no additional payment) · Possible domestic travel assistance for students, postdocs and academic early-career researchers; not guaranteed. · Apply on official page. Topics: physics, neutron science, muon science

item.title: ALPS 2027 — Advanced Language Processing Winter School — LIG (Université Grenoble Alpes) and NAVER Labs Europe
item.description: Dates: 28 Mar – 2 Apr 2027 · 6 days. Location: Europe. Deadline: 2026-10-11. EUR 700 students; EUR 900 academic non-students; EUR 1300 industry and independents (to be confirmed; includes accommodation and full board) · Apply on official page. Topics: natural language processing

item.title: IAHS Academy 2027 — IAHS
item.description: Dates: 11 Jan – 17 Jan 2027 · 7 days. Location: 宁波东方理工大学 Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo (EIT). Deadline: 2026-09-30. EUR 650 (general fee); EUR 350 for participants from Financially Disadvantaged Countries · SYSTA: accepted applicants who meet the award requirements may apply; not guaranteed. · Apply on official page. Topics: hydrology, water resources, geoscience
